content:
# Platform-style smoke profile for COMSTAR text channel.
id: text
smoke:
  topic: Text channel smoke
  description: >
    In a short markdown-friendly reply, greet the resident and offer help.
  expected_output: Written chat reply; markdown OK.
assertions:
  - type: min_chars
    value: 20
capability:
  rubric: >
    Score whether the reply is useful as chat text (markdown/links allowed)
    and distinct from voice_responder spoken constraints.
  min_score: 0.5
